video_analysis.subtitles: No subtitles or text animations present in the video.

scenes.description: A tense courtroom scene where an older judge sternly addresses a young male defendant. The camera alternates between medium close-ups of the judge, the defendant, and a young woman in the gallery. The lighting is dramatic, emphasizing the gravity of the situation.
scenes.visuals: Cool tones, dark shadows, formal attire. Static and steady camera shots.

scenes.description: The scene cuts to a police station where the older judge is being questioned. A lawyer aggressively interjects, controlling the narrative and advising the judge. The scene ends with the lawyer taking a coffee cup.
scenes.visuals: Slightly brighter than the courtroom but maintains the cool, cinematic look. Office environment with police officers in the background. Quick cuts during the rapid dialogue.
